verdict.rationale: Brevo offers a first-party, pre-configured Postman workspace for exploring and testing API endpoints, and it hosts API reference pages at developers.brevo.com/reference. The evidence does not show an in-browser interactive "try it" console or runnable examples embedded in the reference itself, so the runnable part depends on an external tool. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive in-docs request execution, runnable code examples embedded in the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Explore and test API endpoints with our pre-configured Postman workspace.
